bio.text: Ritesh Tandon is the Republican candidate for California's 17th Congressional District in 2026.
Tandon earned a B.S. in mechanical engineering from LD College of Engineering in India and an M.S. in computer engineering and an M.B.A. from Santa Clara University.

The career includes serving as CEO of Kricel Corporation and working as a research fellow at UC Berkeley; according to the Ballotpedia candidate survey, Tandon worked at Cisco for 11 years and has lived in Silicon Valley for two decades.
